name: Fly for Brainrots!
desc:
Welcome to Fly For Brainrots 🪁

1. Fly and Steal Brainrots hidden on platforms!  ⚠️
2. Don't get caught by the Guards! 👮
3. Bring them back to your Base to earn Cash! 🏠
4. Upgrade your Speed - Reach Higher platforms! ⚡

If you're having fun, don’t forget to hit the thumbs up! 👍
